items.title: DeepSeek Cut Its KV-Cache HBM Need 75% and SSD Need 87.5%. Micron and Sandisk Investors Should Pay Attention
items.summary: The memory-shortage thesis assumes AI usage and memory demand rise together. DeepSeek just supplied a reason that relationship may be weaker.
